headlines.description: — Anton Lundell scored the go-ahead goal in the third period and A.J. Greer scored twice as the Florida Panthers beat the Buffalo Sabres 4-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Greer's 2-goal game powers Panthers to a 4-3 victory over the Sabres

events.name: Carolina Hurricanes at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Andrew Copp scored at 3:27 of overtime, lifting the Detroit Red Wings to a 4-3 win over the Carolina Hurricanes on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Copp scores in OT, lifts Red Wings to 4-3 win over Hurricanes after retiring Sergei Fedorov's jersey

events.name: Seattle Kraken at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Berkly Catton scored the tiebreaking goal in the third period, and the Seattle Kraken rallied from two goals down and beat the New York Rangers 4-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Catton scores tiebreaking goal in 3rd period as Kraken rally from 2 goals down and beat Rangers 4-2

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Philadelphia Flyers

headlines.description: — Brandon Hagel, Jake Guentzel and Nikita Kucherov each had a goal and an assist as the Tampa Bay Lightning notched their 10th consecutive victory with a 5-1 win over the Philadelphia Flyers on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lightning beat Flyers for 10th straight win as Cooper notches 600th win

headlines.description: — Mike Matheson and Juraj Slafkovsky scored goals 37 seconds apart to start the third period, propelling the Montreal Canadiens to a 6-3 win over the last-place Vancouver Canucks on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Canadiens defeat Canucks 6-3 with 3-goal outburst in third period

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Minnesota Wild

headlines.description: — Jesper Bratt and Ondrej Palat each scored twice and the New Jersey Devils beat the Minnesota Wild 5-2 on Monday night to snap a four-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jesper Bratt, Ondrej Palat each score 2 goals as Devils beat Wild 5-2 to snap four-game skid

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid extended his career-high point streak to 19 games, helping the Edmonton Oilers beat the short-handed Chicago Blackhawks 4-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McDavid and Bouchard help the Oilers beat the Blackhawks 4-1

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Colorado Avalanche

headlines.description: — William Nylander scored 3:59 into overtime and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat Colorado 4-3 on Monday night to snap the Avalanche’s 17-game home win...
headlines.shortLinkText: William Nylander's OT goal gives Leafs 4-3 victory, snaps Avalanche's 17-game home win streak

events.name: Dallas Stars at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Jason Robertson scored late in the third period, Wyatt Johnston scored his 25th goal of the season, and the Dallas Stars defeated the Los Angeles Kings 3-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jason Robertson strikes late in the third period to help send Stars to 3-1 victory over Kings
